race.comment: STORMLAND (11) improved sharply last start at the second run back from a spell, making late ground to clock-in third over 1100m at Warwick Farm. Strips fitter and the extra 100m is what the doctor ordered. Expecting that Sydney midweek form to measure up here. BRAVEHEART (3) is a model of consistency. Added to a long run of top three finishes last time out when runner-up over 1110m here. Has the pace to cross from a wide alley. Sure to give a great sight again. BLAZING HARRY (2) has not been seen since a modest effort over the mile here two months ago. Good fresh performer with a nice record at this trip so don't leave him out of the reckoning. RAZORS (7) is back from a 190-day spell. Has the class to test a field like this if forward enough.
